title: What We Do in the Shadows Seasons 1-6 - Free to Stream with Ads @ SBS on Demand
body:

[Hiphopopotamus] The 2014 Movie is also there, highly recommended if you enjoyed the show.
[PurpleMonkeyDwasher] The movie is the best. Good to watch for Halloween

[Mechz] I thought it went downhill from S4 onwards.

Shut up, Colin Robinson
[RoryLyons] Matt Berry is amazing in this! I appreciate the relevancy of your FOTC username too.

[Thrift] He’s my best friend, he’s my pal, he’s my homeboy, my rotten soldier, my sweet cheese, my good time boy.
[brotherfranciz] Instant +1.
I actually tried looking for the physical media version a few weeks ago, but it seems like it does not exist other than bootleg versions on eBay and AliExpress.
Apparently DVDs exist for the first few seasons but nothing at all for the later seasons, with streaming being the only consistent source available. So this SBS OnDemand broadcast is the next best thing (other than sailing the high seas of course).
[Lucille Bluth] One of those rare instances where a new version is better than the original imo

[derdew] movie was brilliant- remains ridiculously funny even after multiple rewatches. I couldn't get into the show after the movie, as I couldn't get the original actors out of my brain. only gave it a few episodes, but maybe should try it again.
